summary.one_liner: GPT Runner is a tool for managing AI presets stored as xxx.gpt.md files and chatting with AI about selected project code files, available as a CLI, web UI, and VSCode extension.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes GPT-Runner as a way to manage AI presets and hold AI-powered conversations about your code files. You select project files or folders from a file tree, and the AI responds using the current contents of those files. Each AI preset is a readable xxx.gpt.md file that can be kept under git version control and shared with a team. The project also lists customizable AI model parameters, support for third-party LLMs, local data storage, and multiple locales. The README mentions OpenAI and Anthropic keys as requirements. The CLI is launched with npx gptr and opens a web interface in the browser.
use_cases: Chat with AI about multiple project source files
Manage and version-control AI prompt presets with git
Share AI presets across a development team
Run a local web UI for AI-assisted coding
notable: AI presets stored as plain-text xxx.gpt.md files that can be versioned and shared
Select files or folders from a tree to use as chat context
Available as CLI (npx gptr), web page, and VSCode extension
Local data storage described as privacy-first
caveats: Requires an OpenAI or Anthropic API key, per the README
Requires NodeJS >= 16.15.0 for the CLI and VSCode >= 1.78.0 for the extension
Roadmap items (JetBrains plugin, Electron client, preset store) are not yet implemented
The README is short on detailed setup; configuration and UI docs are linked externally
